models & pricing

model prices are listed in units of per 1m tokens. a token, the smallest unit of text that the model recognizes, can be a word, a number, or even a punctuation mark. we bill model usage based on the total number of input and output tokens by the model.

(1) use deepseek-flash as the model name. the legacy names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are still accepted, but the corresponding models have been retired, their requests are served by the deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 model and billed at the flash price.

(2) off-peak rates are half of the peak rates. peak hours are 01:00 - 04:00 and 06:00 - 10:00 utc, monday through friday, excluding chinese public holidays. all other hours are off-peak, including weekends and chinese public holidays in full.

(3) for more details on concurrency limits, please refer to rate limit & isolation.

web search & fetch pricing​

search (text, image) and web fetch are billed per use, whether you call the search and fetch apis directly or the model uses them through tools such as the web tools.

itemunitprice
search (text, image)per 1,000 searches$0.75
web fetchper 1,000 fetches$0.75

for the billing rules, see search & fetch and web tools.

apiunitlist pricelimited-time price (50% off)

deduction rules​

for model usage, the expense = number of tokens × price. search (text, image) and web fetch are charged per use at the rates above. the corresponding fees will be directly deducted from your topped-up balance or granted balance, with a preference for using the granted balance first when both balances are available.

product prices may vary and deepseek reserves the right to adjust them. we recommend topping up based on your actual usage and regularly checking this page for the most recent pricing information.
